_meta.source: Live scrape of bazargoo.com. Product list discovered from https://bazargoo.com/sitemap.xml. For each product page, name/price/image taken from the JSON-LD Product block (offers.price) and category from the JSON-LD BreadcrumbList; compare-at price from the page markup. Stock status (in_stock: true/false/null) comes from offers.availability in the JSON-LD: InStock -> true, OutOfStock/SoldOut -> false, missing or ambiguous -> null.
_meta.live_feed: No public live product feed exists on bazargoo.com (tested 2026-11-08: /products.json 404, /api/products 404, /api/store/products 404, /sitemap-products.xml 404; sitemap.xml lists URLs only, no prices). Prices therefore come from this bundled products.json. Re-run sync-products.py to refresh — no app rebuild needed.
_meta.note: Store's own spellings kept as-is in 'category': 'Cleanning', 'Kithen'. Merged duplicates: 'Home Appliance' into 'Home Appliances', 'Book' into 'Books' (same category, two spellings on the store).
